strokeOrder: draw the short upper head from left to right
continue down and around the deep bowl without lifting

strokeOrderSource.citation: Persian Online, How to Write Persian Characters, ح demonstration at 00:42–00:46 (Liberal Arts Instructional Technology Services, Univ. of Texas at Austin)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The cited freehand lesson demonstrates isolated ح body-first in one continuous Naskh motion: the short upper head travels left to right, then the same pen-down run turns through the hooked descent and deep lower bowl without lifting. Contextual joins reshape the head; this isolated learner path fits the vendored Noto Naskh outline and records Persian-scoped provenance rather than borrowing the separately sourced Arabic or Urdu ح order.

notes: Used mainly in Arabic-derived Persian words; shares its dotless body with the ج and خ family.
